source.title: Average years of schooling
source.subtitle: Average years of formal education for individuals aged 15-64.
source.definition: Average years of formal education for individuals aged 15-64.
source.note: Formal education is primary/ISCED 1 or higher. This does not include years spent repeating grades. Data for the years before 2015 are estimates, while data from 2015 onwards are projections.
source.measurementNote: Years of formal education at primary/ISCED 1 or higher; repeated grades are excluded. Years of schooling do not measure education quality.
source.cohortComparisonNote: Schooling covers ages 15–64; modern literacy generally covers ages 15 and older. Historical literacy definitions and population coverage differ.
source.citation: Barro and Lee (2015); Lee and Lee (2016) – with major processing by Our World in Data
source.fullCitation: Barro and Lee (2015); Lee and Lee (2016) – with major processing by Our World in Data. “Average years of schooling” [dataset]. Barro and Lee, “Projections of Educational Attainment”; Lee and Lee, “Human Capital in the Long Run” [original data].
